title: Adding staff and setting what they can do
summary: Create a login for each person on your team and choose which role controls what they can see and change.

steps.text: On the Users tab in Global Config, use {create} to add a teammate with a name, email, temporary password and role.
{matrix} shows exactly what each role can do; the owner can turn individual permissions on or off for any role except the owner's own.
On {title}, enter the person's name and email, a {pw} they change when they first sign in, and their role, then choose {create}.

You can also ask the assistant to add a staff member, change a member's role or adjust what a role can do. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm. A member it adds gets a generated password, shown once on the card after you confirm, so pass it on before you leave the card.
